name: C9 Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an admission letter from a Kazakhstani university to obtain a Visa Invitation Letter (VIL), then a C9 student visa application at a Kazakhstani embassy/consulate with the VIL, passport (valid 6+ months, 2 blank pages), flight itinerary, passport photo, bank statements, health insurance, and accommodation proof. Documents should be submitted at least one month before the semester start.
requirements.fix_path: Secure university admission, obtain the Visa Invitation Letter, then apply for the C9 visa at a Kazakhstani mission abroad.

outcome.duration_length: 1 academic year (or full academic term for short-term students), multiple entry, renewable annually

sources.title: Narxoz University (Kazakhstani higher-education institution) -- official guide to the C9 student visa: VIL and consulate application process, documents, fees (VIL ~1,846 KZT, multiple-entry visa fee USD 200 as of 2024), and annual renewal

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kazakhstan). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to one university's own international-student guide (tier 3, an academic institution rather than the immigration authority itself), so process details may vary slightly by institution; the C9 visa category itself is a standard government classification referenced consistently across sources reviewed. work_rights set 'restricted' since Kazakhstan's own foreign-labor-quota regulation (adilet.zan.kz, tier 1, cited in kz_work_permit.json) confirms students working part-time at educational institutions are exempt from needing a separate work permit -- implying some limited part-time work right exists, though this file's primary source did not detail it directly, hence 'restricted' rather than 'full' or 'none'.
